test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

He will be / waiting for me when / I reaches his home.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect conjugation of the verb after the subject "I".
 
• The correct form should be "I reach" instead of "I reaches".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part C** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He will be waiting for me when I reach his home."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "He will be,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "waiting for me when,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 1: "No error,"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
